title: LP2-54: fixed ciphertext and plaintext feedback on the red header
question: What do the two explicit one-step feedback rules produce for the nine red runes when the first plaintext rune is A, I or O?
summary: All 58 primer-and-rule outputs are archived. The A/I/O cribs give six deterministic header strings; under ciphertext feedback the following eight runes do not depend on the primer.

family.title: LP2-54 red-header feedback cribs
family.question: Can a specified feedback recurrence and primer read the red one-plus-eight-rune header?

variant.label: Two one-step recurrences and all 29 primers

scope.representation: Archived 232-rune LP2-54 stream in canonical zero-based GP order, with the first nine red runes checked against the literal source prefix; punctuation has no cipher position.
scope.procedure: For each primer 0–28, decrypt the entire stream by P0=C0-k modulo 29 and then either P_i=C_i-C_(i-1) or P_i=C_i-P_(i-1) modulo 29. Re-encrypt every output and independently verify every saved equation. Compare the six outputs whose first rune is A, I or O.
scope.parameters: 29 primers × 2 recurrences = 58 complete outputs of 232 runes; one continuous stream, no word or row reset; one-rune ciphertext or plaintext feedback; no adaptive key or candidate selection.
scope.exclusions: Eight-rune dictionary census; other C/K/D functions; alphabet permutation; lag greater than one; interruption choices; a second encryption layer; language scoring; a claim that all autokey variants fail.

finding: The exact red cipher indices are 24,19,21,23,27,2,14,10,19. For A/I/O first-rune cribs, ciphertext feedback always makes the following eight labels A TH TH R R EO AE N. Plaintext feedback gives three different eight-rune outputs. The source's two named clocks therefore cannot be substituted for each other, and the simple cases do not establish a header reading.
limitations: The source proposes many unspecified functions and possible words; this bounded run implements only the two explicit one-step recurrences. It has no language score or calibrated null, and does not test whether another layer turns the output into text. Human review pending.
next_steps: Pin one additional recurrence, dictionary and rune conversion before searching; count all tried candidates, test known solved text under the same pipeline and score untouched continuation against matched controls.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 standard library; no network or API. Run from the repository or extracted bundle root.

review.reviewer: Codex — full 58-case census, round-trip encryption and independent per-position equation check; human review pending
